units.source_text: “你好像很喜欢那个孩子啊。”老板娘说，

en.t: "You seem to be very fond of that girl," the proprietress said,

units.source_text: “再过两三年就可以出来当舞女了。

en.t: "In another two or three years she will be able to come out and become a dancer.

units.source_text: 你就愉快地……从现在起就耐心地等着吧，

en.t: Look forward to it happily... and wait patiently from now on,

units.source_text: 她准会长成绝代佳人的啊。”

en.t: she is sure to grow into a peerless beauty."
